As a person who is in management, in higher-end sales, or in a refined field, such as medical, teaching, or business, a certain level of professionalism is mandatory. This will involve exercises on pronunciation, syllable emphasis, stress and intonation (and help you sound more credible as a native speaker!).   This class will help you transition from being able to express ideas as an entry-level employee, to being able to express thoughts like a respected, well-versed manager/owner. If you are an actor, businessperson, interpreter, teacher, diplomat, or just wanting to expand your ability to mimic Americans for whatever reason, these classes are for you. As we learn the different theories in the book, we will do additional practice with my own materials for the section covered in the book with the aid of my own phonemic writing system. Although we will go linearly through the course, you will learn and practice things that are covered and emphasized in previous and following sections. Once we have finished the first three chapters, we can do a wide range of activities and be creative and personalized in how we practice that will continually change your accent to be ever more Californian. 
My other goals as a tutor are to be your native speaker connection, answer any questions you might have, share resources, encourage you, give you study tips, teach you slang/idioms/expressions, and get you to continue improving your abilities with English. I love to truly get to know my students and their individual stories~ it always inspires me!
